description: This file declares the interface for a factory class that creates GStreamer decryptor elements within the Rialto server component. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies related to GStreamer and decryption services.

classes.name: IGstDecryptorElementFactory
classes.description: An interface class for creating GStreamer decryptor elements, providing factory creation and decryptor element instantiation methods.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IGstDecryptorElementFactory instance.

methods.name: createDecryptorElement
methods.description: Creates a GStreamer decryptor element with specified name, decryption service, and GStreamer wrapper.
